_comment: Declared containers. Each becomes a systemd unit through Quadlet, so it is supervised, journalled, and comes back after a reboot. The Containers page edits this. Containers started by hand with podman/docker run still appear on the page's live list; they are just not declared here and owe nobody a restart.
_comment_fields: ports are host:container (append /udp for UDP). volumes are source:destination — an absolute source binds a host path, a bare name is a named volume podman manages. environment entries are KEY=value lines. Everything runs on podman's default network; custom networks are out of scope here.
